title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Explore the unique rituals and long-standing customs that define the Wildcat experience at Davidson College.

cards.title: The Freshman Cake Race
cards.subtitle: A 1.7-mile sprint for homemade prizes
cards.notes: Run a 1.7-mile course to win a homemade cake baked by faculty and town residents. This tradition began in 1930 as a way for the track coach to scout new talent.
cards.short_summary: First-year students compete in a campus race where the prizes are elaborate, locally baked cakes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Freshman Cake Race started in 1930 and involves first-year students running a 1.3 to 1.7 mile race to win cakes donated by the community.
cards.source_title: Davidson Cake Race a Sweet College Tradition Since 1930
cards.access_notes: Held annually on the Wednesday of the first week of classes at the Wildcat statue.

cards.title: Honor Code Signing Ceremony
cards.subtitle: A formal pledge of academic integrity
cards.notes: Sign the official Honor Code book during orientation to join a community of trust. This pledge enables unproctored exams and a culture of mutual respect.
cards.short_summary: A foundational ceremony where every new student formally pledges to uphold the college's strict Honor Code.
cards.evidence_claim: The Honor Code signing ceremony is a distinctive moment for first-year students, connecting them to the college's history of trust and responsibility.
cards.access_notes: Takes place in the Chambers Building during new student orientation.

cards.title: Flickerball
cards.subtitle: The unique sport of Davidson
cards.notes: Compete in this hybrid of football and basketball, unique to Davidson since 1951. Freshmen residence halls field teams for intense, high-spirited tournaments.
cards.short_summary: A unique intramural sport created at Davidson as a safer alternative to touch football.
cards.evidence_claim: Flickerball originated in 1951 at Davidson College and is a sport unique to the institution, played in freshman and open leagues.
cards.access_notes: Games are typically held on the intramural fields during the fall semester.

cards.title: Phi and Eu Balcony Debates
cards.subtitle: Quadrennial political shouting matches
cards.notes: Watch student political groups debate from the balconies of Philanthropic and Eumenean Halls. This quadrennial tradition coincides with U.S. presidential elections.
cards.short_summary: Lively political debates held between the historic halls of the college's oldest literary societies.
cards.evidence_claim: During presidential election years, college democrats and republicans debate from the balconies of Eu and Phi Halls, a tradition dating back to the 1800s.
cards.access_notes: Occurs every four years during the fall of a U.S. presidential election year on the Historic Quad.

cards.title: The Midnight Scream
cards.subtitle: A collective release of exam stress
cards.notes: Join the campus-wide shout at midnight on the night before final exams begin. It is a brief, loud moment of solidarity to release academic pressure.
cards.short_summary: A tradition where students gather to scream collectively at midnight to relieve stress before finals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Midnight Scream happens before the first day of exams as students across campus come together to release stress.
cards.access_notes: Occurs at midnight on the night of Reading Day before final exams.

cards.title: Self-Scheduled Exams
cards.subtitle: The ultimate test of the Honor Code
cards.notes: Pick up your exam and take it at a time and location of your choice during finals week. This practice relies entirely on the student's commitment to the Honor Code.
cards.short_summary: A unique academic practice where students choose when and where to take their final examinations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Honor Code allows Davidson to administer final exams in a way that gives students flexibility through self-scheduling.
cards.access_notes: Available to students during the final exam period each semester.

cards.title: Christmas Vespers
cards.subtitle: A candlelight service of lessons and carols
cards.notes: Attend the annual candlelight service featuring the Davidson College Choirs and scripture readings. It is a peaceful community event held in the campus church.
cards.short_summary: A traditional holiday service featuring choral music and candlelight in the college's historic church.
cards.evidence_claim: Christmas Vespers is an annual candlelight worship service featuring choral music and scripture readings at the Davidson College Presbyterian Church.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in early December; free and open to the public.

cards.title: The Old Well Legend
cards.subtitle: A superstition for campus sweethearts
cards.notes: Visit the historic well on the quad, where legend says a kiss ensures a future marriage. It remains one of the most photographed and storied spots on campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus landmark associated with a romantic superstition about future marriage.
cards.evidence_claim: Legend has it that young couples who share a kiss by the Old Well will be granted luck in love and eventually marry.
cards.access_notes: Located on the Historic Quad and accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Spring Convocation
cards.subtitle: A celebration of student achievement
cards.notes: Gather in the Duke Family Performance Hall to recognize academic and leadership awards. Seniors wear their caps and gowns for the first time in this 'dress rehearsal'.
cards.short_summary: An annual ceremony honoring student excellence where seniors debut their graduation regalia.
cards.evidence_claim: Spring Convocation is an annual ceremony that recognizes student achievement and leadership, with seniors attending in caps and gowns.
cards.source_title: Many Bright Lights: Davidson College Celebrates Spring Convocation
cards.access_notes: Held annually in April at the Duke Family Performance Hall.

cards.title: Senior Mug Night
cards.subtitle: A commemorative gift for graduating Wildcats
cards.notes: Receive a personalized Davidson mug as a gift from the Alumni Association. This event marks the transition from student to alumnus for the graduating class.
cards.short_summary: A celebratory event where seniors receive a commemorative mug to mark their upcoming graduation.
cards.evidence_claim: Senior Celebration & Mug Night is an event hosted by Alumni and Family Engagement to honor the graduating class.
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the spring for the graduating senior class.
